name: Lajas (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and pale yellow crossed by a white vertical stripe near the hoist forming a cross, charged at its centre with a ripe pineapple surrounded by eleven gold stars.
history: Lajas is a town and municipality located in the Lajas Valley in southwestern Puerto Rico, bordering the Caribbean Sea, south of San Germán and Sabana Grande; east of Cabo Rojo; and west of Guánica. The flag was adopted on 13 September 1982 (according to Flags of the World).

features.role: eleven stars in a ring around the pineapple
